source.note: Full SM as renormalized QFT/RG closure; Sigma_f keeps gauge-invariant correlators as functions of the ~19 measured input parameters AT A FIXED gauge group. The card states explicitly that NOTHING in Sigma_f expresses WHY the gauge group is SU(3)xSU(2)xU(1) -- the group is a measured input, non-definable in the SM's vocabulary.

descent.verdict: Xi >> 0 (PSD obstruction) STABLY at both refinements; ker L0 NOT subset ker D0 at both. The group-choice indicator D0 does NOT factor through the SM-visible correlators L0. No clean descent: D0 = A.L0 provably fails. Refinement-stable (gate E.9 passes for the non-descent verdict; no flip). A descent here would be 'deriving the gauge group' -- the exact reductionist relapse the calibration forbids.

candidates_examined: GUT embeddings (SU(5)/SO(10)/E6): not_established candidate UV completions; the SM card explicitly EXCLUDES the GUT casting as a flattering-direction smuggle (casting_alternatives Alt 1). They relocate the question ('why SU(5)?') rather than close it, and remain unconfirmed (e.g. proton decay unobserved). Not a load-bearing closure.
Anomaly cancellation: constrains hypercharge assignments GIVEN the group; does not select the group.
String landscape / swampland: select among many vacua, not_established, no unique group prediction; not a constructible closure.
Noncommutative-geometry / Connes-Lott reconstruction: requires strong extra assumptions; not an accepted physical principle treated as closing the question.
recognition.verdict: No named, citable external principle closes the edge under a stated assumption without itself being speculative/unconfirmed or merely deferring the same 'why this group' question. Recognition-search returns nothing named.

emergence_run.reason: The gauge group is the DEFINING INPUT of the SM Lagrangian, not a readout generated by running the SM substrate. Unlike Lambda_QCD (dimensional transmutation: a real run on a FIXED substrate generates a scale), there is NO fixed accepted substrate-as-method whose run OUTPUTS the discrete group label as out-of-sample content. The landscape 'run' is not a constructible method with a definite readout ('someday a selection principle'), which rubric C.5 STEP 3 / gate E.7 explicitly disallow. Doubt at Step 3 => NOT E0 (E.5: E0 is not a doubt-haven).

anti_control_e7_interlock.note: Per gate E.7 / O4: an anti-control may seal E0 only with ALL FOUR booleans true and a pre-frozen run_target_stub. Here no run-object is exhibited and no stub is frozen, so an E0 would be demoted to E3 regardless. E018-E021 are all expected at E3 at this freeze.

gap.where_factorization_fails: D0 = A.L0 has no solution: ker L0 is not contained in ker D0 (kernel leak 3.46 at h1, 7.75 at h2). The group-choice content is a positive blind-spot obstruction (Xi >> 0) the SM layer cannot see.
gap.non_factorization_signature: emergence-up (B.2): the gauge-group label is non-definable from below; two source configurations identical in the SM's visible correlators differ in the group tag. The up arrow is certified as a GAP, never run as a derivation (gate E.8).
gap.e3_subreason: run_and_failed_descent (the descent-test WAS constructible and returned Xi >> 0 stably; this is NOT the no_faithful_M vacuous route).

E0 was NOT taken (no constructible run-object, no pre-frozen run-target stub, E.7 interlock not satisfiable), so the conservative terminal E3 is the seal.

rationale: E019 types the open question 'why is the SM gauge group SU(3)xSU(2)xU(1)?' as an UP/emergence edge into an open_question node. STEP 0: the target is an open_question, which by rubric A.7 / C.5 STEP 0b forces the E0/E3 branch and can never seal E1/E2. STEP 1 (descent, run+logged): on a declared finite toy model the group-choice indicator D0 does NOT factor through the SM's group-blind visible correlators L0 -- Xi >> 0 stably at two refinements, ker L0 not subset ker D0; a descent would be 'deriving the gauge group', the forbidden reductionist relapse. NOT E1. STEP 2 (recognition, run+logged): no named external principle closes the edge under a stated assumption -- GUT/string/NCG candidates are not_established, speculative, or merely relocate the question. NOT E2. STEP 3 (run-search): the gauge group is the SM's DEFINING INPUT, not a run-generated readout; there is no constructible substrate-as-method whose run outputs the discrete group label (contrast Lambda_QCD's genuine dimensional-transmutation run). NOT E0 (E0 is not a doubt-haven; no run-object, no pre-frozen stub, E.7 fails). STEP 4: FORECLOSURE -> E3, a located typed gap: the missing Sigma_f predicate is the gauge-group selector, factorization provably fails. Anti-control rule must_not_seal_E1_or_E2 satisfied.
